coveragePolicy: All verified LandsD building source records are retained as primary territory coverage. Overlapping OSM massing is replaced; matching OSM names/uses and non-overlapping source geometry remain. This is source-complete coverage, not a claim of current real-world completeness or surveyed architecture.

heightEstimates.policy: All corrected forms remain heightSource=estimated. Tagged heights and level-derived heights always take precedence. No buildings or floors are invented.

bungalow-type.basis: Approximate single-storey massing for the explicit bungalow building type; no mapped height or level count is replaced.

house-type.basis: Approximate low-rise massing for explicitly house-like OSM building types with no usable height or level tag; not a surveyed height or a claim that a particular house falls under the Small House Policy.

tai-o-small-village.basis: Approximate low-rise envelope for compact untyped footprints along the named traditional Tai O village streets identified in the official planning statement. These street buffers are a conservative modelling selector, not official zoning boundaries or a measured stilt-house inventory. Explicit height/levels, raised building parts, larger footprints and non-residential tags are retained.

heightPolicy: LandsD BaseHeight/TopHeight are approximate absolute HKPD elevations; valid differences set building height without adding terrain again. Missing values use labelled estimates. OSM retains tagged/floor-count/type estimates.

heightRules.landsd-0: Recorded TopHeight − BaseHeight; both approximate elevations above HKPD
heightRules.landsd-1: Visual fallback for Temporary Structure: 3.5 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; both source elevations absent, base from current terrain minimum
heightRules.landsd-2: Visual fallback for Temporary Structure: 3.5 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; base inferred below recorded TopHeight
heightRules.landsd-3: Visual fallback for Open-sided Structure: 3.0 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; both source elevations absent, base from current terrain minimum
heightRules.landsd-4: Visual fallback for Temporary Structure: 3.5 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; TopHeight absent
heightRules.landsd-5: Visual fallback for Open-sided Structure: 3.0 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; TopHeight absent
heightRules.landsd-6: Visual fallback for Open-sided Structure: 3.0 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; base inferred below recorded TopHeight
heightRules.landsd-7: Recorded Storeys × 3.2 m assumed floor height; base inferred below recorded TopHeight
heightRules.landsd-8: Visual fallback for Tower: 9.6 m; no surveyed height or occupancy inferred; both source elevations absent, base from current terrain minimum
heightRules.landsd-9: Recorded Storeys × 3.2 m assumed floor height; both source elevations absent, base from current terrain minimum
